x: A programme of three events gave only a few of our Juniors a chance to show their merit; but Mewes, Crilly, Keyworth, Dyke, Martin, Chantler and Clements certainly seized the opportunity to show their superiority over the other clubs.
A Belgrave team of Dyke, Bone and Mewes was entered. Evidently it was a regular race as previous times of 10.8 etc are given and winners had been Poly and Blackheath.
